# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/goreleaser
# args: 

  Release engineering, simplified.                                                                                      
                                                                                                                        
  GoReleaser is a release automation tool, built with love and care by @caarlos0 and many contributors.                 
                                                                                                                        
  Complete documentation is available at https://goreleaser.com                                                         
         
  USAGE  
         
    goreleaser [command] [--flags]  
            
  EXAMPLES  
            
    # Initialize your project:      
    goreleaser init                 
                                    
    # Verify your configuration:    
    goreleaser check                
                                    
    # Verify dependencies:          
    goreleaser healthcheck          
                                    
    # Build the binaries only:      
    goreleaser build                
                                    
    # Run a snapshot release:       
    goreleaser release --snapshot   
                                    
    # Run a complete release:       
    goreleaser release              
            
  COMMANDS  
            
    build [--flags]                        Builds the current project
    check [configuration files] [--flags]  Checks if configuration is valid
    completion [command]                   Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
    healthcheck [--flags]                  Checks if needed tools are installed
    help [command]                         Help about any command
    init [--flags]                         Generates a .goreleaser.yaml file
    jsonschema [--flags]                   Outputs goreleaser's JSON schema
    release [--flags]                      Releases the current project
         
  FLAGS  
         
    -h --help                              Help for goreleaser
    --verbose                              Enable verbose mode
    -v --version                           Version for goreleaser
